title: 第十二章 薅恶人羊毛！
slug: 抢恶姐婚约随军被禁欲大佬亲哭
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

虽说她现在唬住了这夫妻俩，可这个年代没有监控，等他们和朱顺反应过来，一定会咬死不认的。

到时候，她手里的这些证据远远不够。

再说这事真捅出去了，林家臭了，沈家就未必同意她和沈时觐的这门婚事了。

既然这样，她倒不如借这个机会狠宰他们一笔，这样她手里能有些傍身钱，她也能替可怜的原主出口恶气。

至于她为什么跟他们要一千块，她记得书里有说过，林柔嫁给沈时觐的时候，他们陪嫁的是五百块。

她比那个绿茶婊优秀那么多，双倍嫁妆是应该的。

说起来，她没为难他们。

一千块？陈琴和林大国简直要气疯了。

他们两个靠着在家里种点地，赶大集卖菜卖鸡鸭过日子，行情好的时候一个月能赚个六七十块钱，不好的时候一个月满打满算才赚三四十块钱。

这个死丫头上下嘴唇一碰就要一千？

还当是给她的陪嫁？

呸！她当自己是柔柔呢？她配吗？

再说了，就算是柔柔，他们也舍不得给这么多啊。

陈琴眉头拧成了疙瘩：“一千块？这话你也说得出口，咱家的情况你还不清楚吗？我们上哪给你弄一千块去？”

“你这丫头，心咋这么黑呢！就算我们有错，也把你养到这么大了，你不能翅膀硬了就往死里逼我们吧？”

林大国阴沉着脸，冲她摆摆手：“要钱没有，要命两条，你自己看着办吧！”

林栀知道他们不好对付，是时候拿出最后一个杀手锏了。

“你们想害的不只是我，还有沈时觐，要不是我们俩换了房间，沈时觐提前喝了醒酒药，林柔可就得逞了，你们这可是妨碍军婚罪，真追究下来，你们小心吃不了兜着走。”

咳咳咳……

昨晚她才爬了沈时觐的床。

说到这儿的时候，她心虚地瞄了沈时觐一眼。

见他没啥反应，心里稍稍平静了些。

这话一落地，林家夫妻真是害怕了，他们哪里惹得起他啊。

他们纷纷看向沈时觐，刚要求饶，林栀又开口了。

“我和沈时觐就要结婚了，我的意思就是他的意思，你们求他不如求我。”

沈时觐侧过身，淡淡瞥了林栀一眼，唇角动了动想说些什么，思忖片刻，终是什么都没说。

在林家夫妻眼里，沈时觐什么都不说，就等同默认了。

陈琴望向林栀，脸色缓和了下来，捏着衣角说：“闺女，不是爹妈不舍得，实在是家里日子过得紧巴，我上哪给你凑这么大一笔钱去？”

林栀立刻板起脸来：“我最烦别人跟我讨价还价了，现在涨了，一千一百块。”

“一千块我们都拿不出来，更不要说……”

“现在又涨了，一千二百块。你们究竟是想蹲局子还是拿钱消灾，自己选。”

“另外我再提醒你们一句，这事一旦捅出去了，林柔这辈子就别想再嫁人了，你们舍得吗？”

林栀扭头看了眼墙上的挂钟。

“我没太多耐心，给你们五分钟时间考虑。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Although she has frightened the couple now, there is no surveillance in this era. When they and Zhu Shun react, they will definitely deny it.

By then, the evidence in her hand would not be enough.

Besides, if this matter is really revealed, the Lin family will be in trouble, and the Shen family may not agree to her marriage to Shen Shijin.

In this case, she might as well take this opportunity to kill them, so that she can have some money in her hands, and she can vent her anger on the poor original owner.

As for why she asked them for a thousand yuan, she remembered that it was said in the book that when Lin Rou married Shen Shijin, they gave her a dowry of five hundred yuan.

She is so much better than that green tea bitch, she deserves a double dowry.

Speaking of which, she didn't make things difficult for them.

One thousand yuan?Chen Qin and Lin Daguo were going crazy.

The two of them make a living by growing some land at home and going to market to sell vegetables and chickens and ducks. When the market is good, they can earn sixty or seventy yuan a month. When the market is not good, they only earn thirty or forty yuan a month.

The touch of this damn girl's upper and lower lips costs a thousand?

Think of it as a dowry for her?

Pooh!Does she think she is Rourou?Is she worthy?

Besides, even Rourou, they are reluctant to give so much.

Chen Qin's brows knitted into knots: "A thousand dollars? You can say this. Don't you know the situation of our family? Where can we get you a thousand dollars?"

"You girl, why do you have such a dark heart! Even if we are at fault, we have raised you to such a big age. You can't just force us to death when your wings are hard, right?"

Lin Daguo had a gloomy look on his face and waved his hand at her: "Is it money or your life? It's up to you!"

Lin Zhi knew that they were difficult to deal with, so it was time to come up with the last trump card.

"It's not just me you want to harm, but also Shen Shijin. If we hadn't changed rooms and Shen Shijin had drank the sobering medicine in advance, Lin Rouke would have succeeded. You are guilty of obstructing a military marriage. If we are really prosecuted, you will not be able to get away with it."

Cough cough cough…

She just climbed into Shen Shijin's bed last night.

When she said this, she glanced at Shen Shijin guiltily.

Seeing that he didn't react, I felt a little calmer.

As soon as these words came to light, the Lin family couple were really scared. How could they afford to offend him.

They all looked at Shen Shijin, and just as they begged for mercy, Lin Zhi spoke again.

"Shen Shijin and I are about to get married. What I want is what he wants. It's better to ask him than to ask me."

Shen Shijin turned sideways, glanced at Lin Zhi lightly, moved the corners of his lips to say something, thought for a moment, but said nothing.

In the eyes of the Lin family and his wife, Shen Shijin's not saying anything was tantamount to acquiescence.

Chen Qin looked at Lin Zhi, her face softened, she pinched the corner of her clothes and said, "My daughter, it's not that my parents are reluctant to part with it, it's just that life at home is tight. Where can I get such a large sum of money for you?"

Lin Zhi immediately made a serious face: "I hate others bargaining with me the most, and now it has gone up to 1,100 yuan."

"We can't even come up with a thousand yuan, let alone..."

"Now it's gone up again, to 1,200 yuan. Whether you want to stay in the game or use money to eliminate disasters, it's your choice."

"Also, let me remind you that once this matter is revealed, Lin Rou will never get married again in her life. Are you willing to do so?"

Lin Zhi turned to look at the clock on the wall.

"I don't have much patience. I'll give you five minutes to think about it."
